messages:
samir: deploy-bot flagged prod promotion from staging for payments-service. Postupgrade hook failing on jobs/migrate. Chart bumped to 3.4.0 in staging, prod still at 3.3.2. values overlay for eu-west has new `db.poolSize` + `migratorRole`. rollout blocked. @mike can you take a look?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] promotion blocked: postupgrade hook failed. job/payments-migrate exited 1. logs: /deploy/logs/4288882345. auto-retry scheduled but will wait for human decision.

mike: looking now. quick glance at pod logs shows `psql: error: role \"payments_migrator\" does not exist` during migration. did we change creds or role name in staging overlay? @ashley any recent db-related value changes? :eyes: 

ashley: yes — yesterday I updated the migration image and added `migratorRole: payments_migrator` in the staging overlay when we rolled schema v5. i forgot to add it to prod overlay. sorry, that explains the missing role. options: add overlay to prod now (risky) or pin chart/version and postpone.

irene: given this touches db roles, i'd prefer pinning to avoid accidental schema drift in prod. pin the chart to 3.3.2 and schedule a coordinated db + values change in a change window. 

samir: agree. plan: 1) abort current promotion, 2) pin payments-service to chart 3.3.2 in deploy-bot, 3) add release-note entry (hold + reason), 4) schedule follow-up change window for migration + prod overlay update. mike/ashley to prepare migration runbook. i'll apply the pin.

mike: ack. i'll prepare runbook. command i'll run to pin: 
```
deployctl pin --service payments-service --chart 3.3.2 --reason \"prod overlay missing migratorRole\"
```
can someone confirm deploy-bot will not auto-retry promotion once pinned?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] auto-retry suppressed for pinned releases. pin will also record an audit entry. pin recorded by samir at 4288882399.

samir: applied pin and aborted promotion. release notes draft: \"Hold promotion to prod for payments-service due to missing migrator DB role in prod overlay; pinned to chart 3.3.2. Follow-up: coordinated migration + values deploy scheduled 2026-04-12 10:00 UTC\". i'll add to release tracker.

ashley: i'll open a prod overlay PR adding `migratorRole` and run the migration in staging once more. will post PR link and a short runbook with rollback steps.

mike: i'll add a pre-promotion canary health-check to verify the migration job exists and exits 0 before promotion proceeds. will include the check in the PR.

irene: thanks. samir, please add a note for the release manager to review the DB migration plan in the change window.

samir: done. release tracker: https://redwood-inference/release-tracker/4288882345 :white_check_mark:
